window: today, whenever you can, in two or three sittings
goal: The whole conceptual half, which is what the objective test is made of. Every one of the 30 test questions comes from these four lessons, and reading business rules exactly is worth more marks than anything else on the paper.
drill: All 30 test questions are inside those lessons. Answer every one, and read the verdict on the options you did not choose.

window: today, later, or first thing tomorrow
goal: The relational half. Turning a diagram into tables, then normalising, then querying. The theory paper leans here, and normalisation appears on every past paper in the folder.
drill: Work each solved past-paper part yourself before reading the answer under it.

goal: Algebra and SQL, then the 25/26 paper end to end. Finish on the paper rather than on new material.
drill: Re-answer any test question you missed yesterday, then stop and eat before the 3pm paper.

window: Monday, only if you have time left before 3pm
goal: Three full mock papers, question paper and answers separately, so you can sit one closed-book. Use them only after the taught lessons are done: they are practice, not teaching.
drill: Sit one paper against the clock rather than reading all three.
